module_summary: 12-hour BCD clock: cascaded seconds/minutes/hours BCD counters advanced on ena, with a rollover-enable chain and an AM/PM toggle.

anchors.name: ss
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD seconds counter 00-59, increments every ena pulse.

anchors.name: mm
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD minutes counter, advances when seconds roll over.

anchors.name: hh
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD hours counter 01-12, advances on minutes rollover.

anchors.name: pm
anchors.why: AM/PM indicator register toggled at 11:59:59 rollover.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Per-digit carry/rollover enable chain decoded from current time.

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Once-per-second tick gating all counter updates.

groups.name: Time counters
groups.description: Cascaded BCD seconds, minutes, hours counters plus AM/PM toggle.

groups.name: Carry chain
groups.description: Rollover comparisons producing per-digit increment enables, gated by ena.
